name: Onee-san ga Oshiete A-Ge-Ru
original_name: お姉さんが教えてア・ゲ・ル
source:
Main character's sister becomes unbearable. His childhood friend organizes a special study program for his sister with a tutor. This program is much wider than just school education disciplines. Protagonist gets really curious about these special lessons...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-november-2005-sharin-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公的姐姐变得令人难以忍受。青梅竹马为姐姐安排了一项由家教负责的特别学习计划。这项计划远不止学校课程，主人公对这些特别课程非常好奇……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-november-2005-sharin-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
